fullContentHtml:
NTA NIFT Online Form 2027 – Full Details

National Testing Agency (NTA) has released the notification for the National Institute of Fashion Technology NIFT 2027 Examination on the official website of the NTA recently. The online application process for NTA NIFT Online Form 2027 has started on 16 October 2026, and candidates can apply till 16 November 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for NTA NIFT Online Form 2027, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 16 October 2026
  • Last Date : 16 November 2026
  • Last Date Fee Payment : 16 November 2026
  • With Late Exam Fee Payment : 21 November 2026
  • Online Correction : 22-25 January 2026
  • Exam Date : 10 January 2027
  • Exam City Intimation: 21 December 2026
  • Admit Card : 04 January 2026

Application Fee

  • Single Programmes
  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 2000/-
  • SC, ST, PwD : Rs. 500/-
  • Both Programmes
  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 3000/-
  • SC, ST, PwD : Rs. 750/-
  • NRI, OCI, Foreign National / SAARC: Rs. 11100/-
  • Late Fee Charge : Rs. 5000/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
